topic: Project SkyNet Urban Drone Delivery Launch Decision: Financial Investment, Consumer Acceptance, UAM Corridor Compliance, and Heavy-Lifter v2 versus Swift-Class Fleet Readiness
objective: To determine whether Project SkyNet should proceed with the urban drone delivery launch by evaluating financial viability, consumer acceptance, regulatory compliance, and fleet readiness, and to recommend a go/no-go decision with supporting evidence.
decision_question: Should SkyNet proceed with the urban drone delivery launch in Q3 2025, and if so, which fleet configuration (Heavy-Lifter v2 or Swift-Class) is more financially and operationally viable?
